entries.name: glib
entries.classification: Moderate upstream unsound VariantStrIter; one issue with two advisory IDs
entries.reason: Frozen desktop lock includes Linux GTK variants. Neither glib nor its VariantStrIter is reachable in the locked x86_64-pc-windows-msvc graph. Linux desktop distribution is unsupported. Exclusion is rechecked from actual Cargo metadata, not assumed from the lock.
entries.followup: Reassess and upgrade the GTK dependency chain before enabling any Linux desktop product target.

entries.name: proc-macro-error
entries.classification: Upstream unmaintained notice; not a demonstrated exploitable issue
entries.reason: Present in the conservative cross-target GTK lock closure and absent from the actual Windows resolve graph. Build-time macro code remains a supply-chain trust concern.
entries.followup: Remove or replace through maintained upstream GTK updates before considering a Linux desktop product.

entries.name: rustls
entries.classification: Conditional TLS secret Debug disclosure, ECH rejection leakage, Brotli allocation and key-share prediction downgrade; upstream fix 0.23.46
entries.reason: Old auth-native and vault-native standalone frozen test locks retain 0.23.45. Installed Windows, Windows helper and content-native locks already use fixed 0.23.46. The product Windows graph must contain only rustls >=0.23.46, no glib/proc-macro-error, and no Brotli decompression feature. Old standalone builds are synthetic fixtures, never release inputs. This does not erase the old vulnerable dependency or waive release risk.
entries.followup: P18 must build only the checked Windows root/helper locks. Any future standalone distribution needs a new reviewed lock profile with 0.23.46 or later; preserve the old fixture locks as historical evidence.

entries.name: zip
entries.classification: Upstream privileged-mode and symlink extraction advisories; fixed upstream in9.0.0, vulnerable frozen version retained
entries.reason: Only the pinned Tauri updater depends on this runtime version. The host now checks PE/MZ format after both signature and hash verification and before Tauri format dispatch; signed ZIP payloads are denied too. MZ and the pinned infer PK detector are disjoint. The actual installed Windows gate must reject a correctly signed symlink ZIP while still performing its genuine signed NSIS upgrade. Exact crate sources and call ordering are rechecked, not a generic archive waiver.
entries.followup: Upgrade through a separately reviewed maintained lock profile before supporting ZIP/MSI archives or any new updater/target. Qualified review and production release remain blocked; the upstream vulnerable code is not claimed patched.

entries.name: zip
entries.classification: Upstream extraction advisories; build-only dependency accepts an upstream-key authenticated vendor archive before extraction
entries.reason: Actual Windows metadata proves this is solely the libsodium-sys-stable build dependency, absent from the normal runtime closure. Frozen crate source proves complete vendor archive verification with the pinned minisign key before extraction, including local override input. Runtime API/UI/user recovery archives never reach this build script. This is a scoped input/authority disposition, not an upstream fix or independent supply-chain audit.
entries.followup: Adopt a maintained fixed dependency profile without rewriting historical locks. Reassess for any new build target, source override, signing authority or archive path; upstream/vendor/build-host compromise remains an independent review concern.

entries.name: zbus_names
entries.classification: Informational upstream unmaintained notice; standalone functionality moved into zbus6, no demonstrated vulnerability in this notice
entries.reason: Present only in the conservative desktop cross-target lock. The actual locked x86_64-pc-windows-msvc resolve graph, including build/test features, contains none of zbus_names, zvariant or zvariant_derive. Linux native desktop distribution is unsupported; this is not an exclusion for browser/PWA code or for future executable targets. Exact version/ID and affected lock membership remain checked.
entries.followup: Migrate the Linux D-Bus dependency chain to maintained upstream profiles before enabling a Linux native desktop target. Preserve historical locks; new versions/advisory IDs require fresh explicit review. Production and qualified review remain blocked.
